description:
Scope: planning only for lib/zaq/engine/channel_adapter_loader.ex:61. Exclusive edit/test path: test/zaq/engine/channel_adapter_loader_test.exs. Do not edit production code, supervisors, ChannelConfig tests, or other test paths. No implementation/test execution in this planning issue.

Baseline and diagnosis: line 61 is the Logger.info message in load_configs/4 when ChannelConfig.list_enabled_by_kind/2 returns []. Existing tests at channel_adapter_loader_test.exs:63-95 and :115-146 already call that branch and assert []; test/zaq/channels/supervisor_test.exs:358-359 already checks similar logs. Thus coverage reported missed 61 may reflect test selection, stale/different instrumented source, or line-level instrumentation rather than an absent branch; do not assume the new assertion alone changes numerical hits. coveralls.json is configuration only, not a coverage report.

Test-first step 1 (missing line 61): In the existing load_configs/4 describe, strengthen the no-enabled-config test or add one dedicated test. Reuse use Zaq.DataCase, async: true, the real sandboxed Repo, the existing insert_channel_config/1 helper and @adapters; no mock, fixture module, or production seam needed. Wrap ChannelAdapterLoader.load_configs(:retrieval, ["mattermost"], "TestSup", "retrieval") in ExUnit.CaptureLog.capture_log([level: :info], fn -> assert [] = ... end), then assert captured log contains "[TestSup] No enabled retrieval channel configs found, starting empty.". This exercises the empty [] match (59), Logger.info invocation/interpolation (60-62, target 61), and [] return (64); verify both observable log and empty result, not merely is_list/1. No sleeps or polling; synchronous log capture only. Keep setup unseeded for genuine empty DB in isolated sandbox; if using the disabled, wrong-kind, unknown-provider existing scenarios, reuse insert_channel_config/1 and assert the same log to prove filtering without broadening test surface. Optional one separate variant with kind_label: "custom" via children_for/3 to prove supplied label, not needed for target coverage. Do not weaken existing assertions.

Isolation and collaborators: SQL Sandbox remains per-test DataCase ownership with async: true; the call queries synchronously in the owner. CaptureLog is per caller; do not change global logger level, application env, Mox mode, shared process names, ETS, or sandbox shared mode. No extra mocks: ChannelConfig is deterministic real database logic and adapter processes are not started by load_configs/4. StubAdapter and @adapters are already in this test file for children_for/3; no new setup. If logging backend configuration prevents capturing info, use capture_log(level: :info) supported by the local ExUnit version and investigate settings instead of global mutation. If forced to mutate global log settings, move only that scenario to its own async: false module and restore state with on_exit; avoid unless truly unavoidable.

Property assessment: not applicable for a single deterministic empty-list branch and fixed diagnostic message; there is no broad input space, normalization, permission default, idempotency, or ordering invariant requiring ExUnitProperties/StreamData. Existing examples supply boundary and filter coverage; adding a property would obscure this narrow regression.

Validation/handoff: implementing agent runs only mix test test/zaq/engine/channel_adapter_loader_test.exs (and any line-filtered invocation of the same file as needed), confirms captured info text and no DB/log isolation regressions; no full suite or coveralls. Parent session owns mix q and final targeted --cover; parent must ensure this test file is included in its target selection, compare current instrumented source and coverage report line 61, and distinguish instrumentation/test-selection mismatch from unreachable code. If parent coverage still marks line 61 missed while the direct test executes and log is captured, record blocker with exact command, report location and source revision, inspect stale instrumented beams/report and coverage line mapping; do not add redundant tests or alter production just to move a coverage counter. No unreachable branch identified: empty filtered query is reachable. Acceptance: precise info log and [] are asserted on the real public path and parent can account for hit/mismatch without altering nonexclusive files.

Implementation results: Added regression coverage asserting both the exact info diagnostic and [] from the real load_configs/4 path. Test config sets Logger.level to :warning, so capture_log(level: :info) alone could not capture it; the scenario now runs in a dedicated async: false DataCase module and restores the prior logger level with on_exit.

Validation: `mix test test/zaq/engine/channel_adapter_loader_test.exs` — 13 tests, 0 failures (under required flock). No full suite or coverage run.
title: [zaq-hmq] [coverage] Assert empty ChannelAdapterLoader config log (line 61)
